text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Now that we've washed our hands, we
can go to
offer our prayers.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I get in line with Грасс Вандер, and
before long,
our turn arrives.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Now, what to pray for?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Pray that Grass sharpens her running form.

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Being mindful of my condition? How
kind of you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just knowing that you care has
brightened
my spirits.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Stronger, you say? You must be
expecting big
things from me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sharper running, is it? Interesting.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's true, I'm now entering my senior
year. I'll be
up against all the best racers
from here on.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm already on my way to becoming a
"Beast." If I
get even stronger, I might
gobble you up! Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So we must hone my skills to a razor's
edge. I'll be
counting on you, Trainer. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
With this new boost, perhaps I'll start
pushing
myself extra hard... Just kidding.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Now that we have made our prayers...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We should be heading back to the
academy for
training. But since it's a
holiday, why don't we
take our time?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste not to fully take in
the
celebration.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Let's be off, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The two of us take a stroll through the
grounds of
the shrine, replete with the
festive mood of New
Year's.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Except... For some reason, Грасс Вандер
seems
strangely distracted the entire
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I believe I fell into a New
Year's daze.
Hehe, how careless of me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... why don't we begin with the
usual warm
up?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: That's when she appears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A gust of wind! Her signature red!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The swift Phantom Bird has landed on
the field of
battle!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's the world's strongest racer! El
Condor Pasa, in
the hooouse!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Behind her calm smile burns the spirit of
a warrior.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In the eye of the flamin' whirlwind, the
turf is set
aflame! The world is shaken by
a deep blue of
unknown!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Грасс Вандер! To the ring!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Is this... another challenge?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Listen, El, I already have plans for
today...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh. Ya scared, huh?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Think you're gonna relive that shame ya
felt at
the Arima Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I saw the whole thing, Grass. Your
contienda
against Sei.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And it bored me till I was pullin' at my
hair!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My corazón and alma were left utterly
unmoved!
Your race was so lacking in
heat, I almost caught
a cold!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You don't...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: You don't understand a thing, El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
To be refused the opportunity to even
compete!
Denied the chance to claim
the "Beast" name!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Look at me, Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I am the Phantom Bird, rápida like
lightning, the
strongest in the world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The barrera gigante that blocks your
path to the
top!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A wall you must clear at all costs if you
want to
reach your true destination!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Just like Марузенски!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Bein' refused the "Beast" title? What
kinda
nonsense is that?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Your objective—the prize you had your
eye on
this whole time...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Was it nothin' more than a name?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Forget it. You're not invited to the
ring.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If I face ya when you're like this... it'll
just kill the
fire inside me, too.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Adiós.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
After Эль Кондор Паса leaves, Grass
Wonder
stands unmoving, as if frozen in
place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's no approaching her like this. The
air
practically crackles around her as she
stands
there in silence, until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As if shot out from a cannon, she dashes
up to
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you still have the paper
where I wrote
to you my promise?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Her voice is soft, but it's impossible to
miss the
flames blazing just beneath the
surface. If she
means the calligraphy
paper with "determination"
written on it,
then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Would you please hand it to me? Right
now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Chills run down my spine. I pull out the
paper as
fast as I can.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Snatching it out of my grasp, Grass
Wonder holds
up the beautifully written
kanji and—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She shreds it in two.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Determination... What a joke.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I was a coward, too timid to keep
walking along
the path.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски's shadow loomed too tall,
too
grand... and swallowed me whole.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I became trapped by the name "Beast."
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
If I truly reach the pinnacle at the end of
this
path, titles will come naturally.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I won't hesitate anymore.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, Trainer, so allow me to
renew my
promise.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Грасс Вандер takes out a brush.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Determination.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No matter what walls stand in my way, I
will not
flinch before them!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Never again, until the day I reach the
top!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to try running in the
Takarazuka
Kinen as my next race goal.
Would that be
acceptable?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
As with the Arima, entry is determined
by public
vote. What better stage to
demonstrate my
renewed determination?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
When I reach the top, everyone will be
watching!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I apologize for having worried you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
